name: skillopt-03b2f42d-blind30-ots
instr:
# Coding-agent training toolkit returns wrong answers across collection, document editing and configuration, without a test suite

This toolkit reads recordings of earlier coding-agent work, boils them down into practice exercises and written guidance, and hands work out to outside engines. Unrelated things a person does with it began coming back wrong all at once, and nothing in the changelog explains any of it. Nothing about the recordings changed and nothing about the callers changed: the same inputs that used to be handled correctly are handled wrongly now, and in several places a step that used to complete stops with an error instead. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits.

Collecting material from earlier work is the most visible casualty. Scanning a tree of recordings without asking for a cap on how many condensed records come back now fails outright, complaining that a count cannot be compared against nothing, while asking for a cap works. Condensing one recording whose final turn ended in an error no longer carries the negative marker for that failure, though credentials and tokens are still blanked out and the kept message text and the list of tool names come out as they should. Condensing a recording of forty-one user turns and six replies hands back all forty-one turns correctly but keeps the wrong replies: the very first is retained and the second silently dropped, rather than the last five in order.
